---
title: "Alignment and quality control: Sima ChIP-seq"
author: "Yermek Aiten"
output: html_document
---


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# SIMA ChIP-seq Pipeline, Drosophila melanogaster (dm6)
# Transcription factor: Similar (Sima), bHLH-PAS activator (HIF-α homologue)
# Heterodimer partner: Tango (Tgo), analysed in Chapter 3
# Replicates: 2 biological replicates + 1 matched input control
# Library type: SINGLE-END throughout (replicates and control)
# IDR strategy: single biological replicate IDR (rep1 vs rep2); n=2
# ENCODE experiment: ENCSR390QUD (White lab, U. Chicago; embryo, mixed stages)
set -euo pipefail
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# SETTING UP DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
mkdir -p 03_bam 04_qc 07_blacklist 08_qc 09_peaks 10_idr 11_final
mkdir -p $PROJECT_DIR/tmp
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 1, ALIGNMENT (single-end: -U flag)

# ENCFF048IYN = SIMA rep1
# ENCFF309ZFF = SIMA rep2

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
-U 01_fastqc/sima/ENCFF048IYN.fastq.gz \
-S 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.sam -p 8

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
-U 01_fastqc/sima/ENCFF309ZFF.fastq.gz \
-S 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.sam -p 8
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# SAM -> sorted BAM
samtools view -bS 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.sam | samtools sort -o 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.bam
samtools view -bS 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.sam | samtools sort -o 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.bam

rm 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.sam 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.sam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 2, ADD READ GROUPS

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
I=03_bam/SIMA_rep1.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_rep1.RG.bam \
RGID=SIMA_rep1 RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=SIMA_rep1

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
I=03_bam/SIMA_rep2.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_rep2.RG.bam \
RGID=SIMA_rep2 RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit2 RGSM=SIMA_rep2
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# Sort after read groups
samtools sort -@ 8 -o 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.RG.sorted.bam 03_bam/SIMA_rep1.RG.bam
samtools sort -@ 8 -o 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.RG.sorted.bam 03_bam/SIMA_rep2.RG.bam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 3, MARK AND REMOVE DUPLICATES

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
MarkDuplicates \
I=03_bam/SIMA_rep1.RG.sorted.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_rep1.rmdup.bam \
M=04_qc/SIMA_rep1.dup_metrics.txt \
REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
ASSUME_SORTED=true

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
MarkDuplicates \
I=03_bam/SIMA_rep2.RG.sorted.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_rep2.rmdup.bam \
M=04_qc/SIMA_rep2.dup_metrics.txt \
REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
ASSUME_SORTED=true
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 4, FILTER BAM (single-end flags)
# -q 30 : MAPQ \>= 30
# no -f 2 : omitted, -f 2 requires properly paired reads; invalid for SE
# -F 1804 : exclude unmapped, not primary alignment, duplicate, supplementary

for REP in 1 2
do
samtools view -b \
-q 30 \
-F 1804 \
03_bam/SIMA_rep${REP}.rmdup.bam \
> 03_bam/SIMA_rep${REP}.filtered.bam

samtools index 03_bam/SIMA_rep${REP}.filtered.bam
done
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 5, BLACKLIST REMOVAL (uses filtered.bam)

for REP in 1 2
do
bedtools intersect -v \
-a 03_bam/SIMA_rep${REP}.filtered.bam \
-b dm6-blacklist.v2.bed \
> 07_blacklist/SIMA_rep${REP}.clean.bam

samtools index 07_blacklist/SIMA_rep${REP}.clean.bam
done
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 6, CONTROL PROCESSING (single-end: ENCFF936AOH)
bowtie2 -x dm6 \
-U 01_fastqc/sima/ENCFF936AOH.fastq.gz \
-S 03_bam/SIMA_control.sam -p 8

samtools view -bS 03_bam/SIMA_control.sam \
| samtools sort -o 03_bam/SIMA_control.bam

rm 03_bam/SIMA_control.sam

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
I=03_bam/SIMA_control.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_control.RG.bam \
RGID=SIMA_ctrl RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=SIMA_ctrl

samtools sort -@ 8 -o 03_bam/SIMA_control.RG.sorted.bam 03_bam/SIMA_control.RG.bam

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
MarkDuplicates \
I=03_bam/SIMA_control.RG.sorted.bam \
O=03_bam/SIMA_control.rmdup.bam \
M=04_qc/SIMA_control.dup_metrics.txt \
REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
ASSUME_SORTED=true
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# Filter control (single-end: no -f 2)
samtools view -b -q 30 -F 1804 \
03_bam/SIMA_control.rmdup.bam \
> 03_bam/SIMA_control.filtered.bam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# Blacklist removal for control
bedtools intersect -v \
-a 03_bam/SIMA_control.filtered.bam \
-b dm6-blacklist.v2.bed \
> 07_blacklist/SIMA_control.clean.bam
samtools index 07_blacklist/SIMA_control.clean.bam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 7, FRAGMENT SIZE ESTIMATION WITH SPP
# run_spp.R derives the cross-correlation fragment size for single-end data
# Output is used to set --extsize in MACS3 (--shift is not used in this workflow;
# MACS3 --nomodel with --extsize shifts reads by extsize/2 in the 5' direction
# of each strand automatically, which is appropriate for TF ChIP-seq)
run_spp.R \
-c=07_blacklist/SIMA_rep1.clean.bam \
-s=-100:5:600 \
-out=04_qc/SIMA_rep1_spp.clean.txt

run_spp.R \
-c=07_blacklist/SIMA_rep2.clean.bam \
-s=-100:5:600 \
-out=04_qc/SIMA_rep2_spp.clean.txt

run_spp.R \
-c=07_blacklist/SIMA_control.clean.bam \
-s=-100:5:600 \
-out=04_qc/SIMA_control_spp.clean.txt
# Expected: fragment size ~180-230 bp based on SPP on shared White-lab protocol
# Read length is 50 nt (ENCODE table): RSC may be low, similar to TRH (Tag 0/1 expected)
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 8, MERGE REPLICATES INTO POOLED BAM (for signal assignment later)
samtools merge -f 07_blacklist/SIMA_merged.clean.bam \
07_blacklist/SIMA_rep1.clean.bam \
07_blacklist/SIMA_rep2.clean.bam
samtools index 07_blacklist/SIMA_merged.clean.bam
```

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 9, QC: REPLICATE CORRELATION
mkdir -p 08_qc

multiBamSummary bins \
--bamfiles 07_blacklist/SIMA_rep1.clean.bam \
07_blacklist/SIMA_rep2.clean.bam \
-o 08_qc/SIMA.npz
plotCorrelation \
-in 08_qc/SIMA.npz \
--corMethod spearman \
--whatToPlot heatmap \
--plotFile 08_qc/SIMA_spearman_heatmap.pdf \
--outFileCorMatrix 08_qc/SIMA_spearman_matrix.txt
plotCorrelation \
-in 08_qc/SIMA.npz \
--corMethod spearman \
--whatToPlot scatterplot \
--plotFile 08_qc/SIMA_spearman_scatter.pdf
#Spearman interpretation: \>= 0.8 good, 0.6-0.8 moderate, \< 0.6 problematic
#plotCorrelation --outFileCorMatrix
	'SIMA_rep1.clean.bam'	'SIMA_rep2.clean.bam'
'SIMA_rep1.clean.bam'	1.0000	0.9817
'SIMA_rep2.clean.bam'	0.9817	1.0000
```

**SPP fragment-size estimation (QC summary)**

| Sample | Read length | Fragment est. | `--extsize` | NSC | RSC | Quality flag |
|---------|---------|---------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| SIMA_rep1 | 49 bp | 230 bp | 230 | 1.006 | 0.724 | Tag 0 (low RSC) |
| SIMA_rep2 | 49 bp | 220 bp | 220 | 1.010 | 1.032 | Tag 1 |
| **Pooled** |  |  | **225** |  |  |  |

One cannot run IDR on two peak files that were called with different fragment size models — IDR assumes the same peak-calling conditions across both samples. A single consensus `--extsize = 225` (mean of rep1 230 bp and rep2 220 bp) will be used for MACS3, matching the TRH Chapter 3 approach (where `--extsize = 210` was derived as the mean of 205 and 215 bp). `--shift` is not passed to MACS3; the default behaviour of `--nomodel --extsize N` shifts reads by N/2 toward the fragment centre, which is the standard configuration for TF ChIP-seq.

SIMA_rep1 RSC of 0.724 (Tag 0) is below the ENCODE-encouraged threshold of 0.8, matching the pattern seen in TRH (RSC 0.78 / 0.64, both Tag 0). This quality flag is a consequence of the short 49 bp SE reads and modest depth characteristic of the White lab/U. Chicago ChIP protocol and does not invalidate downstream IDR analysis, but will be acknowledged in the QC discussion. Control SPP estimates (150 bp fragment, RSC 0.604) are disregarded — input controls produce cross-correlation artefacts because they lack real enrichment signal.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
# STAGE 10, FINGERPRINT (cumulative enrichment plot)
mkdir -p 04_qc/fingerprint

plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/SIMA_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/SIMA_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/SIMA_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/SIMA_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/SIMA_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  --extendReads 225 \
  -p 8
# --extendReads 225 = pooled SPP estimate from Stage 7 (mean of rep1 230 bp and rep2 220 bp)
```
